_comment: Single source of truth for bay-station routing classes. scripts/layout/apply_rules.py turns 'classes' + group 'patterns' into bay-station.kicad_pro netclasses/patterns and bay-station.kicad_dru; check_gates.py proves KiCad's own matcher agrees. Patterns are KiCad WILDCARDS (* ?) matched against the FULL net name, which for sheet-local nets carries a sheet path with spaces, e.g. '/UWB Array/A0_RF1' -- hence the leading '*'. Derivations: docs/routing-plan.md, scripts/layout/stackup.py.

roles.In1.Cu: GND reference plane (cleared under each DW3210 body)
roles.In2.Cu: GND reference plane (first solid ground per DW3000 DS s7.3)

stackup.er_note: 4.5 is KiCad's FR4 default, not a datasheet/fab value; widths below are re-solved by stackup.py when the fab's Dk is known

fab.name: JLCPCB 4-layer standard (assumed: no fab is named in the repo docs)
fab.source: ~/.claude/skills/jlcpcb/SKILL.md 'PCB Design Rules', multi-layer table (min trace/space 0.09 mm, min via 0.25/0.15 drill); 1/2-layer table annular ring 0.125. Re-check against jlcpcb.com/capabilities before ordering.

groups.description: DW3210 RF1 (pin 18) -> 2.0 pF DC block -> 0R pi pad -> SMA, one chain per anchor, plus the 50 ohm RF2 stub (pin 13) to its 49R9 termination
groups.requirement: 50 ohm single-ended, impedance controlled, 2 pF pads embedded in the track at full width (no discontinuity)
groups.requirement_cite: DW3000 Datasheet v1.1 Table 2 (RF1/RF2) and s7.3, Fig 35; uwb_array_notes.md 'RF front end'
groups.reference_plane: In1.Cu (h=0.254 mm, solid) everywhere outside the DW3210 body cut-out; In2.Cu (h=0.689 mm) only inside the cut-out, i.e. the pad-escape stub
groups.clearance_mm: 0.15 netclass (pad pitch of the DW3210 forces it); 0.5 to foreign tracks/vias/pours via .kicad_dru; GND via fence beside it
groups.vias: none on the line (rule enforced in .kicad_dru); same via count (0) on all four

length_match.measure: pad 18 centre -> SMA centre pad, along the track, incl. the RF2-side stub is NOT included
length_match.cite: positioning.md error budget: outer-anchor differential path needs ~1 cm (~33 ps) and 1 cm = 10 cm at 10 m; uwb_array_notes.md 'Length matching' item 1 asks for identical geometry. 3 ps = ~10 % of the 33 ps budget (design choice, not a datasheet number).

caveats: CONSMA020.042-G footprint is a PLACEHOLDER (centre pad drawn 1.52 mm wide): the SMA launch is not solved here, needs EM simulation at 6.5 GHz
0402 pads are 0.5 mm wide vs 0.45 mm line: embed, do not neck

groups.description: nRF9151 LTE ANT (pin 35) -> pi pads -> J10 u.FL; GNSS pin 42 -> pi pads -> BGA524N6 LNA -> J11 u.FL
groups.requirement: 50 ohm; GNSS line loss <= 0.5 dB; matching network close to the antenna connector
caveats: LTE band edge ~2.2 GHz, GNSS 1.575 GHz: via fence at lambda/10 for 6.49 GHz is more than sufficient
BGA524N6 TSNP pads are 0.2 mm: neck to pad width at the pad only
GNSS_ANT_BIAS is the DNP bias feed (DC, ordinary) and is deliberately NOT in this class

groups.description: LMK1C1104 Yn -> R231-R234 22R -> C24-C27 2200 pF -> DW3210 XTI. Net chain per anchor: CLK_Yn, CLK_Tn, UWB_CLKn
groups.requirement: 38.4 MHz CMOS, 1-2 ns edges, 50 ohm source (ROUT ~50 ohm + 22R); equal length, same layer, same via count, away from SPI and RF; R231-R234 at the buffer pins, C24-C27 at each XTI
groups.requirement_cite: clock_dist_notes.md 'Layout' and 'Terminations'; TI LMK1C1104 SNAS791D (ROUT 50 ohm, skew 25/50 ps); uwb_array_notes.md 'Length matching' item 2
groups.reference_plane: In1.Cu (solid) on F.Cu; none of the four may cross the DW3210 cut-out except at the XTI pad
groups.vias: none preferred; if any, identical count on all four

length_match.measure: sum of CLK_Yn + CLK_Tn + UWB_CLKn track length, buffer pin to XTI pad (R and C pads count as zero)
length_match.cite: clock_dist_notes.md 'Layout' (equal length); positioning.md 33 ps outer-anchor budget. Buffer skew 25/50 ps is fixed and calibrates out; what must not happen is an unequal run whose delay drifts with temperature. 0.5 mm = 3.1 ps is a design choice.

caveats: A0 also carries the DNP crystal Y1/C209 stub and test pads on UWB_CLK0: keep them as short stubs, and mirror an equal stub (or accept the cap difference) on the others -- equal electrical length is only approximate for A0

At 38.4 MHz the line is electrically short (lambda ~ 5 m); the reason for 50 ohm is the 1-2 ns edge (critical length ~ tr/(6*6.15 ps/mm) ~ 27 mm), the reason for equal length is thermal skew stability

groups.description: Rakon U30 RF out (pin 4) -> R230 22R -> U31 CLKIN; the shared 38.4 MHz reference. TCXO_OUT is also test pad TP5.
groups.requirement: single net, as short as possible, not parallel to any RF/SPI line; test pad is a stub
groups.requirement_cite: clock_dist_notes.md 'Terminations', 'Layout'; positioning.md (one oscillator, four matched copies)
caveats: Not part of the four-way matching group: it is common to all anchors, so its delay cancels in TDoA

groups.description: One shared 8 MHz SPI bus (mode 0) to four DW3210, per-anchor CS and IRQ, from the nRF9151 SPIM3
groups.requirement: 8 MHz SPI (host limit; DW3210 allows 36 MHz mode 0). Route SCK/MOSI/MISO together, daisy-chain the four chips with short stubs, keep >= 0.5 mm from CLK/RF
groups.requirement_cite: connectivity_notes.md s2 (SPIM3 8 MHz), uwb_array_notes.md 'SPI mode'; DW3000 DS v1.1 Table 19: t3 setup 14 ns, t4 hold 2 ns, t2 8.5 ns, against a 125 ns period
groups.layer: F.Cu or B.Cu per direction policy

length_match.cite: No matching is REQUIRED: the tightest figure in DS Table 19 is the 2 ns hold, ~330 mm of trace at 6.15 ps/mm. +-10 mm (60 ps) is a hygiene bound, judgement not datasheet.

groups.description: nRF9151 UARTE1 <-> BT840 BLE bridge at 1 Mbaud with RTS/CTS and an IRQ line
groups.requirement: 1 Mbaud (1 us bit time): no length matching, no impedance control; keep away from RF and clock

groups.description: nRF9151 and BT840 SWD (SWDIO/SWDCLK), debug UART. SWO is NOT connected in this design (no SWO net in the contract).
groups.requirement: SWD clock up to a few MHz; keep SWDCLK short and away from RF/clock, series resistors at the source
groups.requirement_cite: programming_debug_notes.md (pin tables, SWO unconnected); net-contract.md s6

groups.description: Input and battery path and the switch nodes: +5V_IN, +VSYS, VBATT_PROT, BATT_RAW, BARREL_VIN, SW_3V3, L1_LTE, L2_LTE
groups.requirement: +VSYS 0.75 A at 5 V, 1.2 A at a 3.0 V cell (power.md s'+VSYS (both converters, eta 0.9)'); MCP73871 input limit 1.8 A; inductor currents to 3.4 A peak (TPS62A02 IHS(OC), SLUSEG9E) on the short switch-node runs
groups.requirement_cite: bay-station/handoff/power.md power budget table; IPC-2221A s6.2
groups.width_basis: IPC-2221 external 35 um, 10 C rise: 1.2 A -> 0.39 mm, 1.8 A -> 0.68 mm; 1.0 mm gives ~2.4 A at 10 C and ~12 mohm per 25 mm. Switch nodes: keep short, no stubs, test pad on the copper (regulation_notes.md)
groups.layer: F.Cu / B.Cu, pours preferred where room

groups.description: Regulated rails: +3V3 and +VBAT_LTE and their regulator-side nets and the nRF9151 VDD feed
groups.requirement: +3V3 ~356 mA peak (446 mA at the VDD_GPIO ceiling); +VBAT_LTE 505 mA TX subframe, VDD impedance < 0.2 ohm 10-50 kHz
groups.width_basis: IPC-2221: 0.5 A -> 0.12 mm, 0.9 A (VBAT_LTE inductor ripple) -> 0.25 mm; 0.5 mm leaves margin and ~1 ohm/m resistance

groups.description: Sheet-local rails after the 0R break links: +3V3_A0..A3, +3V3_TCXO, +3V3_CLKBUF, +3V3_SNS, GNSS_LNA_VCC, NRF_VDD_GPIO
groups.requirement: per anchor: 72 mA RX / 18 mA idle; TCXO 10-15 mA; buffer ~25 mA; VDD_GPIO ~10 mA design
groups.requirement_cite: bay-station/handoff/power.md budget table; DW3000 DS v1.1 Table 5; clock_dist_notes.md

groups.requirement: 400 kHz at most, 3.3k pull-ups; ordinary routing; keep away from SW_3V3/L1/L2 switch nodes (magnetometer)

routing_order: 1. RF_UWB x4 (identical geometry, hand/script, F.Cu, no vias) then lock
3. CLK_UWB x4 (equal length, serpentine on the short ones) and CLK_TCXO, then lock
4. via fences along locked RF lines (route_hs.via_fence), then lock the vias
5. POWER_HI / POWER_MID by hand or pour
6. ordinary nets: route_manhattan.py (F.Cu horizontal, B.Cu vertical)
7. stitch.py on the whole board, then GND zones, fill via kicad-cli on a scratch copy
